known_open: Foundation supports cession alone or with political terms. Military and cuboid combinations remain rejected until their complete joint coordinator paths are implemented.
Command syntax is chunk:<world>:<x>:<z>:<keep>; one coordinate per token. Existing treaty term limits apply. API batches permit at most 256 distinct coordinates.
The joint authorities recover by original operation; this is not an instantaneous cross-database transaction.
Persistent foundation installation binding and detection of externally restored whole authorities across restarts remain open.
Tests use real file/SQLite War, Diplomacy and Foundation owners with Bukkit/scheduler doubles. Lost reply injection does not represent actual game-server process termination.
Siege, legacy military restriction migration/permissioned lifting, lease/reparation/tribute/loan money remain open.
Navy transport/ports, wounded return, doctrine, budget rollover/cancel, other module authorization/thread/lifecycle and archival remain open.
Full clean Core build, new artifacts, final Core plus Supply regression, SQL multiprocess/MySQL and user-deferred Paper/Folia acceptance remain open.
